purpose: Identical Air-first then Pro acceptance; private logs and paths stay outside Git

cases.title: Native preflight and preservation
cases.procedure: Open the remote desktop/native menu and harmless controls before faults. Verify package signature/hash and known fixture bundle. Capture actual workspace-registry, settings, schedules, app/runtime and launch plists. Start own helper/menu only after watchdog ready.
cases.required_result: No daily mutation; isolated helper root/state/destination; provider unknown; same payload on both hosts.

cases.title: Simultaneous picker, aliases and distinct paths
cases.procedure: In one native picker choose choices/Project A, Project B and Duplicate A. Check draft dedup to exactly two paths. Cancel a draft. Remove a draft row, review/save; restart helper and menu. Re-add/remove monitoring with reviewed saves.
cases.required_result: Exact resolved selection, distinct same-named IDs, no cancelled write; saved IDs persist; removed repo archive/settings remain.

cases.title: Startup, request timeout and cache expiry
cases.procedure: Restart native with helper stopped. Observe checking/unavailable. Start helper, observe recovery. Suspend helper beyond 8s request timeout and 20s cache expiration; record displayed states, then resume/reconnect. Compare immutable original observation in private diagnostic frames. Run false-green counterexample regression separately.
cases.required_result: No green without current evidence; typed timeout/failure/cache reason; no mutation of cached backend fact; recovery and diagnostic reason agree.

cases.title: Denied root and nested file, sibling continuation
cases.procedure: Make baseline fixture archives, record their SHA256 and IDs. Deny Project root (chmod000), restore; separately deny nested README (chmod000). Trigger scoped backup/scan while Accessible changes. Restore permissions exactly and retry/next scan.
cases.required_result: Blocked operation explained, no partial archive publication; previous verified archive bytes intact; accessible sibling still backs up; recovery uses same IDs.

cases.title: Destination denial before and during publication
cases.procedure: Baseline archive then chmod own destination unwritable. Change source and request backup; restore permissions/retry. Use controlled real-publication revocation regression for during-backup timing, with diagnostic assertions, plus actual native blocked/recovery view.
cases.required_result: Old archive/index preserved; clear write-blocked message; restoration recovers. POSIX does not claim TCC.

cases.title: Disk image disappearance, substitution, remount
cases.procedure: Create disposable mounted image inside owned run; copy known Git fixture and reviewed-add it. Record directory/volume identity and schedule. Baseline archive. Unmount; then put replacement directory at former path. Reject pending review. Remove own substitute and remount original.
cases.required_result: Missing never empty success; replacement rejected; original identity, schedule and prior bytes preserved; original remount recovers.

cases.title: Actual macOS source privacy
cases.procedure: Use isolated signed identity/account with only synthetic Desktop repo. Actually refuse the macOS folder request, capture helper readiness/menu and recovery instructions. Restore permission in System Settings for that identity, recheck/restart. Never reset daily TCC or default to Full Disk Access.
cases.required_result: Actual refusal/restoration evidence exists; helper says blocked without inventing privacy diagnosis; previous archive safe; restart recovers. Additional access/account needed means blocked.

cases.title: Actual notification permission lifecycle
cases.procedure: For staging identity request notifications contextually from menu Settings. Actually refuse then grant and revoke through System Settings for staging identity only; restart between states. Trigger synthetic backups throughout.
cases.required_result: Accurate denied/allowed states, no repeat auto prompt; interrupted request not stuck; notification refusal never blocks backup.

cases.title: Readiness, final cleanup and same-candidate comparison
cases.procedure: Recheck source/destination through helper in Settings, background registration/readiness, then restart. Stop staging; inspect watchdog/finally cleanup receipts and daily helper/menu, protected hashes. Compare both hosts matrix/payload digest and exact candidate revision.
cases.required_result: All cases passed with native/API/diagnostic references, unchanged protected configuration and restored daily services; missing evidence is blocked, not passed.

acceptance: All required cases passed on both hosts, same application payload; simulations never substitute actual OS permission evidence.
